claims.claim: All 9 assigned frozen SKUs were retained; none was replaced or removed.
C01-S01 current Apple China public price is CNY6799 for 256GB white.
claims.counterevidence: JD transaction price remains separately unverified

claims.claim: US iPhone 17 is not exact-A to the China-mainland frozen SKU because the model/region hardware differs.
claims.counterevidence: same marketing model/capacity does not overcome hardware-region mismatch

claims.claim: An exact China-region A3521 iPhone 17 listing was observed at USD939.95 but was out of stock, so it is not a convenient overseas option.
C01-S02 eBay exact-region page did not bind its displayed price to Silver 256GB; exact-variant price is therefore null.
claims.counterevidence: page displays a number but selector state is not bound to required configuration

claims.claim: C01-S03 JD current price is unobserved; the earlier process-note CNY2998 is withdrawn. The USD495 eBay unit is used/modified and therefore C, not A.
claims.counterevidence: none sufficient to restore a current JD price

claims.claim: C02-S01 and C02-S02 expose numeric public display prices, but subsidy tagging prevents treating them as verified ordinary non-subsidized checkout prices.
claims.counterevidence: a logged-out checkout showing the same price could upgrade status

claims.claim: C02-S03 exact page publicly displays CNY5199 while authenticated take-home price is unobserved.
The two frozen Wi-Fi iPad A16 variants have same A3354 hardware model and matching standard bundle across the checked China/US official pages, so the US offers are A.
claims.counterevidence: regional service/warranty terms were not evaluated as hardware SKU attributes

claims.claim: C03-S03 Lenovo official page currently says the exact product is off shelf; the frozen CNY4299 reference is retained but not used as a current price.
claims.counterevidence: older listings may still show historical price

claims.claim: Community pages are retained as contextual consumer evidence only and are not used for current price or landed-cost inference.
Duty-free de minimis treatment remains suspended under the reviewed 2026 executive action.
claims.counterevidence: product-specific statutory exceptions were not separately mapped

claims.claim: The reviewed Section 122 temporary surcharge instrument specified an end date of 2026-07-24 absent extension; no continuing SKU-level rate is applied here.
claims.counterevidence: a later extension not captured by the reviewed instrument would require update

claims.claim: The 2026 USTR forced-labor Section 301 action cannot be converted into SKU-level duty amounts here without product classification and exemption mapping.
claims.counterevidence: a broker/CBP determination plus current annex mapping could close the gap

claims.claim: No assigned SKU has a complete verified landed total or savings because mandatory logistics/customs inputs remain missing.

data_gaps: No SKU has a complete real standalone shipping quote to ZIP10001.
No consolidated-marginal freight allocation quote was observed.
No true physical bulk-import lot/freight quote was observed.
No SKU-specific current HTS/MFN/Section301 exemption determination was closed from primary tariff records.
No packed chargeable weight was verified; the 0.477kg iPad figure is device weight only.
No FX conversion is applied because no landed total or verified cross-currency savings is computed.
Marketplace offers whose destination was not explicitly ZIP10001 are retained as evidence but excluded from verified savings.
US state/local sales or use tax is excluded throughout.
Sources and model attestations remain subject to coordinator review.
